Combat Gear potion of cure serious wounds;
Other Gear +2 chainmail, +1 khopesh*, daggers (4), brooch of shielding, cloak of resistance +1, backpack, masterwork manacles, hemp rope, silver holy symbol, waterskin, 43 gp
